text:
Maintainerr's image runs as UID 1000 and cannot chown its own data directory, so the directory must exist and be owned by 1000:1000 before the first Harbormaster run or the container exits. Harbormaster only creates data/<app_id>, not the per-service subdirectory, so Docker creates it root-owned.

An init sidecar (an alpine container mounting the same path, chowning it, and exiting, with depends_on: service_completed_successfully) was designed and rejected as too much machinery for a one-time manual step. A 'user: 0:0' override to run as root was also rejected, to keep the image's non-root design. The agreed solution is the manual mkdir + chown documented in the README.

Reopen the sidecar idea only if fresh installs or backup restores become frequent enough that the manual step is actually being missed.

qBittorrent's torrenting port 35945 is published on all interfaces, unlike every other port in the stack, which is localhost-only behind an ingress proxy. This is intentional and agreed: BitTorrent peers dial in directly and cannot be proxied. It also needs forwarding at the router, TCP and UDP.

Before this, the mappings were 127.0.0.1:35945:6688/tcp and 127.0.0.1:35945:6881/udp. Both were dead: the localhost bind made inbound peers impossible, and 6688 was a typo for 6881 so nothing was even listening on the TCP side. TORRENTING_PORT is now set to 35945 so the host and container ports match, because qBittorrent announces the port it binds to.

qBittorrent rejects any request whose Host header names a port different from the one it listens on, returning 401 Unauthorized before it checks credentials. The symptom looks like a wrong password, which sends you chasing the rotating temporary admin password instead of the real cause.

This bit us once already: WEBUI_PORT was 8080 while the mapping was 127.0.0.1:35944:8080, so the WebUI was unreachable. WEBUI_PORT and the host side of the mapping must always be the same number.

The same check breaks it behind Caddy, because the proxied Host header is the public hostname with no port. Caddy needs 'header_up Host {upstream_hostport}' in the reverse_proxy block so qBittorrent sees 127.0.0.1:35944. That config lives outside this repo, so there is nothing here to remind you of it.
